builtin_no_exec_clauses.reason: shell builtin; produces no exec event; unresolvable-by-design

declared_entrypoint.note: root /bin/sh -c entrypoint exec is a real, declared, non-clause exec; mapper leaves it unresolved with reason no_eligible_static_candidate

W.note: entrypoint sh exec may be tail-exec'd on the same pid or forked to a child pid; both shapes accepted; entrypoint shell CPU is reported, not gated

M.baseline_method: Exact python3 -c pass child held at exit_group by the probe-9 ptrace oracle; LD_LIBRARY_PATH removed before target exec.

parallel overlap: max(t_exec) < min(t_exit) across stages
ordering: stages exec after c1 exit and exit before c8 exec
